cmd.pidsymbol.help: Beka izimpawu ze-P&ID: amavalvu, imishini, izinsiza, izinto ezisemugqeni nezixhumi. Uma uchofoza isimpawu esisemugqeni wenqubo, umugqa uyanqunywa ngapha nangapha kwaso.
cmd.pidline.help: Dwebela umugqa wenqubo noma umugqa wesignali (womoya, kagesi, softhiwe, ithyubhu ye-capillary). Umugqa wenqubo unenombolo yomugqa eyakhiwe ngobukhulu, insiza, ukulandelana nespesifikheshini.
cmd.pidtag.help: Nikeza isimpawu ithegi nencazelo, noma uthegise yonke imishini engenayo ithegi ngesikhathi sinye (A).
cmd.pidln.help: Setha ubukhulu, insiza nespesifikheshini yemigqa yenqubo, bese uyibalela.
cmd.pidlist.help: Beka uhlu lwemigqa, uhlu lwemishini, inkomba yezinsiza noma uhlu lwamavalvu esihlahleni njengethebula elihlala lisalungiswa.
cmd.pidcheck.help: Hlola udwebo ukuze uthole izinto ezingenathegi, amathegi aphindwayo, amaphelo emigqa avulekile nokunye, bese uzoomela kuwo ngamunye.
ask.tag.inst: Ithegi lensiza: izinhlamvu (FIC) noma izinhlamvu nenombolo (FIC-101)
ask.pidln: Chofoza umugqa ukuze usethe (insiza {svc}, ubukhulu {size}, ispesifikheshini {spec}; inombolo entsha ngayinye: {next})
done.autotag.skipped: Izinsiza {n} zidinga izinhlamvu zazo: zithegise ngayinye.
done.table: Uhlu lukule shidi futhi lusalungiswa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
err.notline: Akukho mugqa wenqubo noma wesignali lapho.
check.ln-changes: Umugqa {a} uyangena umugqa {b} kungekho lutho phakathi kwawo: engeza i-reducer noma ukuphuma kwespesifikheshini.
proc.err.file: Lelo fayela alisiyo imodeli yenqubo ye-CadCraft.
proc.err.none: Lo mdwebo awunayo imodeli yenqubo okwamanje. Vula enye ngo-IMPORT, noma ucele umsizi akhe isitshalo.
proc.err.noinst: Awekho amathegi ezinsimbi noma amavalvu okuthumela ngaphandle.
proc.done.run: Izinyunithi: {units}; imisakazo: {streams}; {linked} exhunyiwe manje kulo mdwebo. Amaphutha: {errors}, izexwayiso: {warnings}.
proc.done.size: {ln} manje ingu: {size}; izicucu zomugqa ezibuyekeziwe: {n}; ijubane {v} m/s, ukwehla {dp} bar.
cmd.pidproc.help: Xhuma umdwebo kumodeli yenqubo, uyisebenzise, udwebe ithebula lemisakazo, ushintshe usayizi womugqa uwulandele kuyo yonke, noma uhlu lwemigqa yesistimu yokulawula.
ctl.io: Amachaneli: {ai} analog in, {ao} analog out, {di} digital in, {do} digital out (ngaphambi kwezingxenye ezengeziwe).
ctl.noloops: Akukatholakali amalophu anamadivayisi amabili noma ngaphezulu phakathi kwamathegi.
import.dexpi.empty: {name} alinawo amandla, amavalvu noma imigqa ezinophawu lwe-P&ID lalo.
cmd.pidcalc.help: Sebenzisa isibali senqubo (flash, flowsheet, exchanger, vessel, network, pipe stress, relief, HAZOP, LOPA, consequence nokunye) ubone imiphumela yaso nezinkinga zaso.
calc.lede: Khetha isibali, uhlele isampula yokufaka, bese usisebenzisa. Yisisiza sokubala, hhayi ukuvunyelwa kwezobunjiniyela: izinhlamvu ezibhaliwe zimakwe ukuze zibuyekezwe.
cmd.pidzone.help: Dweba izindawo zengozi ezivela esibalini sendawo esishidini: imibhoshongo esipulanini, noma isigaba esidlula ekukhishweni. Amagatsha AREA-ZONE0, AREA-ZONE1 no-AREA-ZONE2. Ukuhlola okusheshayo, hhayi ukuvunyelwa kwezobunjiniyela.
zone.none: Azikho izindawo zokudweba: qala usebenzise isibali sendawo bese uhlola izinkinga zaso.
cmd.pidhazop.help: Buyekeza imigqa ye-HAZOP umsizi wakho ayiphakamisile: yamukele noma yenqaba ngegama. Umsizi akasoze ayamukele yedwa.
hazop.none: Asikho okwamanje ishidi le-HAZOP: dweba izinto namathegi, noma vumela umsizi wakho aphakamise izindawo kule P&ID.
hazop.head: Ishidi le-HAZOP: izindawo {nodes}, imigqa {rows}, {open} elinde ithimba.
hazop.ids: Yiziphi imigqa (izinkomba ezinjengo R1 R2, noma konke)
feeds.none: Akukho thebula lemisakazo elifakiwe kulesi sikhathi. Sebenzisa kuqala Ngenisa › Ithebula lemisakazo (CSV noma Excel).
feeds.done: Ukondla kwemodeli yenqubo kusethiwe: {n}. Kusuka: {name}. Imisakazo engasetshenziswanga: {skipped}.
cmd.pidfeeds.help: Setha ukondla kwemodeli yenqubo kusuka ethebula lemisakazo oyingenise (Ngenisa › Ithebula lemisakazo)
sketch.lede: Dweba isakhiwo: chofoza ukuze ubeke i-athomu (ijoyine leyo emakiwe), chofoza ama-athomu amabili ukuze uwaxhume, chofoza futhi ama-athomu amabili ebhondi ukuze ube yibhondi eliphindwe kabili noma kathathu. Chofoza kwesokudla ukuze uqede ingoyi.
sketch.hint: Chofoza indawo yokudweba ukuze ubeke i-athomu lokuqala.
sketch.ringhint: Chofoza indawo engenalutho ukuze ubeke indandatho.
wire.in: Umugqa {ln}: usayizi {size} ku-3D. I-P&ID wawuthathile. Izicucu zomugqa ezishintshiwe: {n}.
wire.in.model: Imodeli yenqubo ifikile ({name}); izicucu zomugqa ezishintshiwe: {n}.
cmd.pidsources.help: Funda imithombo yokukhishwa kusuka ezinto nezixhumanisi zomdwebo, uyihlukanise ngephakheji yesibali sendawo, bese ugcina izindawo ze-PIDZONE. Ukuhlola okusheshayo, hhayi ukuvunyelwa kwezobunjiniyela; ayihloliwe ngunjiniyela.
cmd.pidconseq.help: Dweba izindawo zesibali semiphumela esishidini (imisebe, ukuqhuma noma izindawo zomusi) emagatsheni CONSEQ-1, CONSEQ-2 … Ukuhlola okusheshayo; ayihloliwe ngunjiniyela.
cmd.pidrelief.help: Linganisa ivalvu lokukhipha ngokufaka kwesibali sokukhipha, bese ubhala inhlamvu yalo ye-orifice nendawo yalo esimbeni. Ayihloliwe ngunjiniyela.
src.done: Izindawo: {n}, izinto zomdwebo: {items}. Sebenzisa PIDZONE ukuze uzidwebe.
cmd.pidpfd.help: Dweba umdwebo wenqubo yokugeleza wemodeli yenqubo: izinyunithi ezikholomini ngokugeleza, imisakazo ngamagama ayo, izinga lokushisa nengcindezi, okubuyela emuva phezulu, nethebula lemisakazo ngaphansi kwalo.
cmd.pidhen.help: Dweba igridi yenethiwekhi yomshintshi wokushisa kusuka kudatha yemisakazo (ukuklama kwe-pinch): imisakazo eshisayo phezulu, ebandayo ngaphansi, umugqa we-pinch, okuhambisana nemisebenzi yakho, izishisi nezipholisi.
cmd.pidnode.help: Dweba umngcele wendawo ye-HAZOP ngamakhona amabili. Amathegi ezinto nezinombolo zemigqa ngaphakathi zigcwalisa inodi, futhi igcinwa kanye nomdwebo.
cmd.pidlive.help: Beka amanani esitshalo eduze kwezimpawu ezinamathegi, ezikhombisa isimo ngemibala: kusuka ku-CSV yomlandi (tag,time,value,quality) noma kuxhumo lesitshalo le-Studio. Ukufunda kuphela.
cmd.pidtubesheet.help: Dweba ishidi lamatyubhu omshintshi wokushisa kusuka kudatha yesibali somshintshi: isigqoko, wonke amatyubhu, nomkhondo wokudlula.
cmd.pidplume.help: Dweba imigqa yesimo somusi wesitaki kusibali somoya esishidini, kanye nesitaki, utolo womoya, nesaziso sokuthi lokhu kuhlolwa okusheshayo, hhayi imodeli yemvume.
pfd.ask: Ikhona yesobunxele eliphansi lomdwebo (Enter ukuze ukhanseleke)
pfd.nosolve: Uhlelo lwezinto alubalwanga ({why}); umdwebo udwetshwe ngaphandle kwezinga lokushisa nengcindezi.
pfd.done: Umdwebo wenqubo yokugeleza udwetshiwe: izinyunithi {units}, izinto {n}, nethebula lemisakazo.
hen.ask.streams: Idatha yemisakazo njenge-JSON [{{Ts, Tt, CP}}…] (CP ngo-kW/K, isikali esisodwa sokushisa)
hen.ask.at: Ikhona yesobunxele eliphezulu legridi (Enter ukuze ukhanseleke)
hen.done: Igridi idwetshiwe: ukuhambisana {matches}, izishisi {heaters}, izipholisi {coolers}, izinyunithi {units} ngokungenani {min} ({n} izinto).
node.ask.name: Igama lenodi
node.done: Inodi {id} {name}: izinto ezinamathegi {tags} nemigqa {lines} ngaphakathi. Igcinwe kanye nomdwebo.
live.notags: Akukho zimpawu ezinamathegi esishidini zokubeka amanani eduze kwazo.
live.ask.csv: Izilinganiso njenge-CSV enomugqa wekhanda tag,time,value,quality (sebenzisa \n ukuze uqhubeke emugqeni omusha), noma Enter ukuze ufunde kuxhumo lesitshalo le-Studio
live.needs: Nikeza izilinganiso njenge-CSV, noma vula lo mdwebo ku-CadCraft Studio bese uvumela uxhumo lwesitshalo lwayo. Isiphequluli sodwa asikwazi ukufunda isitshalo.
live.done: Amalebula amanani adwetshiwe: {n}. Amathegi angenasimpawu: {missing}. Amanothi kuZinkinga: {problems}.
plume.ask.wind: Umoya uvela (amadigri ngokuhamba kwewashi kusuka enyakatho)
plume.done: Umusi udwetshiwe: izimo {contours}; izinto {n}. Ukuhlola okusheshayo, hhayi i-AERMOD.
loops.lede: Bopha ngalinye lamalophu omdwebo kulokho okufunda nokushayela kumodeli yesitshalo, uyisebenzise, bese usebenzisa ama-faceplate. Imodeli, hhayi isitshalo.
loops.spec: Imodeli yesitshalo (JSON: amathangi, ama-reactor, amavalvu, imithombo)
loops.none: Akukho malophu anomlawuli kulo mdwebo okwamanje.
loops.nobound: Akukabi khona umlawuli obophwe ekulinganisweni nasekukhiphweni.
live.lede: Bonisa izilinganiso zesitshalo noma sakhiwo esisemdwebeni. Ukufunda kuphela: akukho lapha okubhalela idivayisi noma okukhulumisa i-alamu. Idivayisi ekheli elisesidlangalaleni idinga ukuvuma kwakho kulowo mphathi.
live.check.done: Amathegi {tags} kumadivayisi {devices} ahlolwe: izinto {problems} okufanele uzibheke.
live.bridge.none: Ukufunda idivayisi kudinga i-CadCraft Studio: ikhasi lesiphequluli alikwazi ukuvula uxhumo lwesitshalo. Sebenzisa i-CSV yezilinganiso okwamanje.
live.note: Idatha yesitshalo nesakhiwo efundwayo kuphela, yokubuka nokuqhathanisa. Hhayi uhlelo lwe-alamu noma umsebenzi wokuphepha.
timer.lede: Gcina iseshini ye-HAZOP ngesikhathi. Setha amaminithi endodeni ngayinye, qala iwashi endodeni ethi ithimba liyixoxayo, uqhubeke uma isiqedile. Isikhathi esedlule siyabonakala, asiphoqwa.
timer.none: Asikho inodi okwamanje. Dweba umngcele wenodi nge-PIDNODE kuqala.
timer.note: Usizo lokufunda eqenjini. Ibhalela isikhathi; ayinqumi ukuthi inodi iqediwe.
cmd.pidcapeopen.help: Yabelana ngale modeli yenqubo nezisebenzisi zenqubo ezamukela izingxenye ze-CAPE-OPEN (Windows), noma sebenzisa iyunithi ye-CAPE-OPEN kolunye uhlelo kule modeli. Akukahloliwe nesilinganisi.
co.classes: I-Studio ibhalisa amaklasi {n} ngomsebenzisi wakho we-Windows (awudingi amalungelo omlawuli).
co.windows: I-CAPE-OPEN isebenza kuphela ku-CadCraft Studio ku-Windows, futhi ingxenye ye-Studio aikakhiwa noma ihlolwe okwamanje. Bheka isihloko sosizo esithi CAPE-OPEN.
co.nobridge: Le kopi ayinalo ibhuloho le-CAPE-OPEN. Idinga i-CadCraft Studio ku-Windows enengxenye ye-CAPE-OPEN efakiwe, engakatholakali okwamanje. Iyunithi ihlala emodelini futhi iyashiywa lapho imodeli isebenza.
co.solve.none: Imodeli yenqubo ayinayo iyunithi ye-CAPE-OPEN. Engeza enye ngo-"Sebenzisa iyunithi ye-CAPE-OPEN".
co.solved: Ukusebenza kuqedile. Kuhlanganisiwe: {ok}. Iziyunithi zohlelo lwenye yona zisebenze izikhathi {calls} ezigabeni {passes}.
co.list.none: I-Studio ayitholanga iziyunithi ze-CAPE-OPEN kulesi sikhombisi.
co.ask.prog: I-ProgID yeyunithi noma i-class id (kumadokhumenti wohlelo lwenye yona)
co.ask.inports: Amagama amaport okungena eyunithi, ngolandelelano olufanayo
co.ask.outports: Amagama amaport okuphuma eyunithi, ngolandelelano olufanayo
co.ask.params: Amapharamitha okusetha, njengo-Pressure=300000; Efficiency=0.7 (amayunithi e-SI; shiya kungenalutho uma engekho)
co.bad.id: "{id}" ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa: kufanele iqale ngohlamvu, ibe nezinhlamvu ezingama-24 noma ngaphansi, futhi ingabe ayikho emodelini.
co.bad.prog: Lokho akuyi-ProgID (njengo-Vendor.Unit.1) noma i-class id enezimpawu ezigoqayo.
co.bad.out: Isitrimu ngasinye esisha kudingeka igama elisha: liqale ngohlamvu, libe nezinhlamvu ezingama-24 noma ngaphansi, futhi lingabe likhona emodelini.
co.bad.ports: Nikeza igama leport elilodwa ngesitrimu ngasinye.
co.added: Iyunithi {id} ({prog}) yengezwe kumodeli yenqubo: ngena {ins}, phuma {outs}.
